parameters.name: ContainerGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the ECI instance on which the CommitContainer task is performed.
You must specify this parameter or TaskId.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description:
The number of entries to return on each page.
Maximum value: 50.
Default value: 10.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The query credential. Set the value to the NextToken value returned in the last API call.

parameters.name: TaskStatus
parameters.description:
The status of the task. Valid values:

- Running

- Succeeded

- Failed
